family_reports.body: All Judges must be held accountable for their actions, verdicts and behaviors. The fact that they ignore evidence and place children in unhealthy environments is disgraceful. That is State created danger doctrine all day long.
Destroyed my family and severed my relationship with my daughter.

Judge Duel I believe was being paid off or bribed by my ex husband attorney. Divorce began in 2020 and due to pandemic no court reporter or transcripts yet he claims he reviewed all evidence and made his decision after 3 plus years and over 20 days of trial that also spanned 3 years. Significant delays of trial by Judge and other side Attorney simply not showing up. Judge and other Attorney have a long relationship with me and should have never been allowed to handle my divorce. He was asked to step down and said no and he asked other attorney to step down and he said and he we are. Ive been abused by my ex and he is using the legal system to do so.

public_comments.comment_text: Did not follow processes allowed significant delays of trial. rule based on emotions such as my protective order he signed and then the next trial day he was angry he had to ask the other side witnesses to leave courtroom as he had every single. He literally tossed the court binder and then took away my protective order. in which he still has to ask the people to leave. Other side but angry I asked. He repeatedly accepted false claims with no evidence and put me in contempt. My ex never followed his orders and yet nothing was done except granting my ex more of what he wanted. Example ex stopped taking alcohol tests and with bank statements showing his alcohol purchases, Judge did nothing but start allowing full visitation. My ex was court ordered to move out of my house and get a job with no deadlines so it took as solid 2 years. my ex refused to do the appraisal process with nothing appraised and I was awarded purchase price yet 2 years later the Judge allowed them to come in and say the travel trailer was to old and such and Judge literally just took it off the balance. while Knowing Kim Rennie Mitchel has stolen all my court documents and he would not let me defend myself. even denying my first ever request for continuation. The court house records do not reflect when I was in court and we have requested the records over a month ago. The court does not show accurate purchase of transcripts either. absolutely ignored court rules and process. no transcripts for 2 years and 5 years later claims he made a fair decision after reviewing evidence. He knew my documents were stolen by my paid off fraudulent attorney and refused to help and denied a continuation forcing me to argue on financial items with no facts. He ruled multiple times and would just unrule those things based on his mood.
